sources.name: ARBK — Kosovo Business Registration Agency (Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve)
sources.verdict: Canonical national commercial register with free open search by business name/ID (owners, activities, capital). Verified live, but the site is a JavaScript SPA (server returns a ~6KB shell) — needs a headless browser; no documented public API or bulk download. The national open-data portal that historically carried registry dumps (opendata.rks-gov.net) was unreachable at check time.

sources.name: CBK/BQK — Central Bank of Kosovo, Licensed Financial Institutions registers
sources.verdict: Kosovo's unified financial regulator (no separate securities commission exists). Register sections verified for banks, microfinance institutions (MFIs), non-bank financial institutions (IFJB), insurers, insurance intermediaries, pension funds and confirmed actuaries. WordPress HTML, parseable with a normal browser UA (blocks some bot UAs with 403 — use browser user-agent).

sources.name: CBK — Pension funds supervision register
sources.verdict: CBK is also the pension regulator; page verified. Kosovo has only two supplementary pension vehicles beyond Trusti — thin but complete LP-regulator coverage.

sources.name: CBK — Statistics (monthly financial system data, time series)
sources.verdict: Verified. Monthly statistics bulletin, financial-system time series, credit registry publications and NPL/late-payment data — downloadable series; the market-sizing backbone for the private-debt side.

sources.name: ERO/ZRRE — Energy Regulatory Office licensee lists
sources.verdict: Verified live (title 'Ballina | ZRRE'). Licenses generators, suppliers and renewable-energy projects — the register route for energy-transition real assets. License lists published mainly as HTML/PDF; structure not deeply verified.

sources.name: KPMM — Independent Commission for Mines and Minerals
sources.verdict: Verified live. Mining licenses and exploration permits — relevant for real-assets sourcing (Trepça ecosystem, quarries, minerals).

sources.name: ARKEP — Regulatory Authority for Electronic and Postal Communications
sources.verdict: Responds 200 but page structure could not be confirmed (no title extracted). Authorization register for telecom/fiber operators — the digital-infrastructure entity route. Needs manual inspection.

sources.name: FSDK — Deposit Insurance Fund of Kosovo
sources.verdict: Verified live. Publishes member (insured) banks — a clean cross-check list for the banking sector.

sources.name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës — Official Gazette
sources.verdict: Verified: authoritative gazette with search (title/keyword/full-text) in 5 languages (sq/en/sr/tr/bs). ASP.NET postback-driven navigation — content retrieval needs a headless browser or the mobile app's backend; not simple parseable HTML.

sources.name: Kosovo Judiciary portal (Gjyqësori i Kosovës) — incl. Commercial Court decisions
sources.verdict: Cloudflare challenge blocks automated fetch. This is the insolvency route: Kosovo has no standalone insolvency register — bankruptcy/liquidation cases run through the Commercial Court (est. 2022) and decisions are published on this portal. Headless browser required.

sources.name: Ministry of Justice — Bankruptcy Administrators roll (Administratorët Falimentues)
sources.verdict: Verified: dedicated Ministry of Justice page for licensed bankruptcy administrators (the insolvency-practitioner roll). Ministry also publishes decisions on notaries and other liberal professions as PDFs.

sources.name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo public e-procurement platform
sources.verdict: Verified: official portal (KRPP-managed, sq/sr/en) with public tender information; interactive search is an ASP.NET app with login for participation. For machine access prefer the OCDS portal below.

sources.name: OCDS KRPP — Open Contracting Data Standard portal (procurement open data)
sources.verdict: Verified live and explicitly advertises an OCDS API menu for bulk publication of Kosovo procurement data. The best machine route to contract awards (revenue signals for service-graph and infrastructure entities).

sources.name: KRPP — Public Procurement Regulatory Commission
sources.verdict: Verified live. Rules, notices, blacklists and operator information complementing the OCDS data.

sources.name: KIESA — Kosovo Investment and Enterprise Support Agency
sources.verdict: Verified live (curl; WebFetch fails on malformed response headers). Investment guides, SEZ/incentive information, investor announcements.

sources.name: PAK/AKP — Privatization Agency of Kosovo
sources.verdict: Verified live (title 'Agjencia Kosovare e Privatizimit'). Publishes privatization waves, asset sale tenders and liquidation notices of socially-owned enterprises — the single richest special-situations/distressed deal-flow source in Kosovo.

sources.name: KCGF — Kosovo Credit Guarantee Fund (Fondi Kosovar për Garanci Kreditore)
sources.verdict: Verified: independent guarantee institution (est. 2016); publishes registered partner banks/MFIs/NBFIs, annual and impact reports, newsletters — sq/en/sr. Maps the SME-credit ecosystem.

sources.name: Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës)
sources.verdict: Verified live. Member bank directory plus sector publications and positions.

sources.name: AMIK — Association of Microfinance Institutions of Kosovo
sources.verdict: Verified live. Member MFIs/NBFIs — a key private-debt-side directory in a market where microfinance is a major credit channel.

sources.name: Kosovo Chamber of Commerce (Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës)
sources.verdict: Verified live. Corporate membership, sector groupings and business announcements.

sources.name: AmCham Kosovo — American Chamber of Commerce
sources.verdict: Verified live. Member directory skews to the largest corporates, banks, law and advisory firms — useful for the institutional service graph.

sources.name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association
sources.verdict: Verified live. Member directory of ICT companies — the VC-adjacent tech ecosystem spine.

sources.name: ICK — Innovation Centre Kosovo
sources.verdict: Verified live. Incubated/accelerated startup lists and program announcements — primary local source for early-stage VC pipeline (also a Dealroom ecosystem data contributor).

sources.name: OAK — Kosovo Bar Association (Oda e Avokatëve të Kosovës)
sources.verdict: Verified live. Advocate directory — the route to mapping M&A/restructuring law capacity for the service graph.

sources.name: ONK — Kosovo Chamber of Notaries (Oda e Noterëve)
sources.verdict: Verified live. Notary directory (transaction infrastructure for real-estate deals).

sources.name: Ministry of Finance, Labour and Transfers (MFPT)
sources.category: Ministry of finance — state debt, POEs, appraiser licensing
sources.verdict: Verified live. State debt program, publicly-owned-enterprise reporting, tax policy; also the licensing authority for property appraisers (no clean online roll verified — see searchedButAbsent).

sources.name: ATK — Tax Administration of Kosovo
sources.category: Tax authority — taxpayer verification, debtor lists
sources.verdict: Verified live. Taxpayer/fiscal-number verification and periodic tax-debtor publications — distress signal source.

sources.name: ASK — Kosovo Agency of Statistics (askdata)
sources.verdict: Verified live (200). Enterprise statistics, construction permits, FDI and sector data via askdata cubes — market-sizing layer.

sources.name: Kosovo Geoportal — Kosovo Cadastral Agency
sources.verdict: Verified live (title 'Kosovo Geoportal'). Parcel/cadastre viewing is a JS map application; useful for real-assets verification, not bulk entity data.

sources.name: Trusti — Kosovo Pension Savings Trust (FKPK)
sources.verdict: Verified: the dominant institutional investor in Kosovo (mandatory second pillar). Publishes quarterly Schedule of Assets (full holdings), acquisition/sale records, unit prices and annual reports — an unusually transparent LP. No RSS.

sources.name: EBRD — Projects database (Kosovo filter)
sources.verdict: URL verified live. Project summary documents filterable by country — primary record of DFI-backed private-sector deals in Kosovo (also the underlying source for much of Preqin/PitchBook's thin Kosovo coverage).

sources.name: BQK/CBK — News & press releases (regulator signal feed)
sources.verdict: Verified: WordPress feed live. License grants/revocations, enforcement and financial-stability announcements — highest-authority signal source in the market.

sources.name: Telegrafi (Biznes/Ekonomi)
sources.verdict: Verified: main feed live (category-specific /ekonomi/feed/ returns 404 — use main feed and filter). One of the highest-traffic Kosovo portals with a dedicated business section.

sources.name: Kallxo (BIRN Kosovo)
sources.verdict: Verified feed. BIRN's investigative platform — procurement, corruption and corporate-governance investigations; strong distress/negative-signal source.

sources.name: Buletini Ekonomik
sources.verdict: Verified feed. Kosovo's dedicated economics outlet — banking, energy, procurement and company news; the closest thing to a financial daily.

sources.name: Prishtina Insight (BIRN, English)
sources.verdict: Verified feed. English-language BIRN outlet — economy and politics analysis; the main English signal source for Kosovo.

sources.name: Gazeta Express
sources.verdict: Verified feed. High-traffic portal with economy coverage.

sources.name: Ekonomia Online
sources.verdict: Verified feed. Economy-focused portal covering companies, banking and energy.

sources.name: Klan Kosova
sources.verdict: Verified feed. Major broadcaster with business coverage.

sources.name: Insajderi
sources.verdict: Verified feed. Investigative outlet — procurement and corporate wrongdoing signals.

sources.name: Koha.net (Koha Ditore)
sources.verdict: Verified feed. Kosovo's most established daily; economy section.

sources.name: Indeksonline
sources.verdict: Verified feed. High-volume portal with economy category.

sources.name: Zëri
sources.verdict: Verified feed. Established daily with economy coverage.

sources.name: Reporteri
sources.verdict: Verified feed. General portal with business items.

sources.name: Radio Evropa e Lirë (RFE/RL Kosovo)
sources.verdict: Verified: RFE/RL API-format RSS feed live. Reliable coverage of economy, energy and rule-of-law — good provenance discipline.

sources.name: KosovaPress
sources.verdict: Site live but /feed/ returns HTML, not XML — no working RSS found. Wire agency useful for official announcements; scrape via HTML index if used.

sources.name: Kosovo 2.0
sources.verdict: Site live but /feed/ returns HTML — no working RSS found. Long-form context pieces on economy/society; low frequency, secondary priority.

competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: DFI disclosures (EBRD project summary documents, IFC disclosures), GP press releases — all reachable directly via the EBRD projects database catalogued above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Sparse: occasional Kosovo startup rounds and the rare regional PE deal touching Kosovo assets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company/investor press releases, international tech media, self-reported profiles; local underlying signals are Telegrafi/Prishtina Insight-type coverage we ingest directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best startup-side coverage of Kosovo among globals, via Western Balkans ecosystem partnerships; tracks Kosovo startups, rounds and hubs.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Ecosystem partners' data (Innovation Centre Kosovo, STIKK member lists), founder self-reporting, local startup news — ICK and STIKK are catalogued directly above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: SEE regional business newswire and company-data products include Kosovo corporate news and TOP-100-SEE style rankings.

searchedButAbsent: Searched (web search budget was exhausted early in session, so verification was done by direct URL probing in Albanian and English) and NOT found, stated honestly: (1) Stock exchange — Kosovo has NO stock exchange, no listed-issuer regime and no CSD for equities; tier4 exchange coverage is structurally empty. (2) Securities/markets regulator — none separate; CBK is the unified regulator; there is no investment-fund (UCITS/AIF) register because no domestic fund industry exists beyond the two CBK-supervised pension vehicles. (3) PE/VC association — no national association exists (no Kosovo chapter of Invest Europe or a regional PEVCA); early-stage ecosystem mapping must go through ICK/STIKK instead. (4) Insurance association of Kosovo — referenced in sector literature but no working public website found (shs-ks.org, oshsk.org both unreachable); CBK's insurer register substitutes fully. (5) Crypto/VASP register — Kosovo's crypto-asset legal framework is recent and CBK does not yet publish a licensee register; nothing MiCA-grade exists (Kosovo is not an EU member). (6) Carbon registry — none; Kosovo is not in the EU ETS. (7) Valuer/appraiser directory — no RICS Kosovo chapter; property-appraiser licensing sits with the Ministry of Finance but no clean online roll was verified. (8) Dedicated insolvency register — none; insolvency runs through the Commercial Court, with decisions on the Cloudflare-protected judiciary portal (catalogued as js-blocked). (9) National open-data portal (opendata.rks-gov.net) — unreachable at check time (connection failure), so historical ARBK bulk datasets could not be confirmed. (10) KOSTT (transmission operator) website — unreachable at check time. (11) Litigation-funding, royalty, ILS or tokenization entities/registries — none found; Niche & Emerging Alts is an honest zero for Kosovo. (12) Nacionale.com RSS — feed 404; outlet excluded rather than padded. Total genuine catalogued sources: 48 (32 entities-side, 16 news-side), below the 50 target because the market is small — every entry above was probed live this session.
